next.reason: 1985: 'The returned value is the absolute value of the approximation of the square root of argument-1.' §2023:15.84.4 RV4 says the same words under native arithmetic. A 1985 program has no ARITHMETIC clause, so by §2023:11.9.5.2 GR4 it is treated as NATIVE. §2023:15.84.4 RV2/RV3 (standard-decimal and standard-binary results) apply only to modes a 1985 program cannot select, so they state no part of this requirement.
